What whoami /priv tells you

The table has three columns, Privilege Name, Description and State:

Privilege Name                Description                          State
============================= ==================================== ========
SeShutdownPrivilege           Shut down the system                 Disabled

Disabled does not mean the account lacks the privilege: it holds it and
a program can enable it when it needs to. A privilege that is not in the
list is one the account does not hold at all.
